{{Top|leg}}
The '''Imperial transmogrification unit''' was a device used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to alter the programming of [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. [[Cornelius Evazan/Legends|Cornelius Evazan]] modified this device to [[Mind transfer device|transfer his consciousness]] into a new body.<ref name="Doctor Death">{{StoryCite|story=Doctor Death: The Tale of Dr. Evazan and Ponda Baba|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>
